Widget family: SLIDER

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):

1. A horizontal track is visible (thin bar spanning most of the control width).
2. A distinct grab handle / thumb is visible on the track — a separable knob (rounded rect or circle) that is thicker than the track itself.
3. Optional filled portion of the track (from start to thumb) may be present and must end at the handle.
4. FAIL if: only a solid bar with no separable handle, only endpoints with no thumb, a bare progress bar, or empty/missing control.
5. When DISABLED: track and handle are visibly dimmed (lower contrast) vs enabled.

HOVER may emphasize the handle/track slightly without removing the handle.
